title: Show 3D Gumball Only When Transform Utility Active
description: Puzzle 3D currently defaults the host-unset active utility to `move`, so selecting an object shows the gumball even when no transform utility is pressed in the utility bar (and Escape-cleared utilities fall back to move again). Only show the gumball when move/rotate/scale is explicitly active.
summary:
Fixed Puzzle 3D gumball still showing when transform looks inactive.

Root causes beyond the earlier empty-default fix: (1) collapsing the Transform utility collection left move/rotate/scale pressed while the ribbon looked idle; (2) the world host defaulted missing transformMode to move; (3) transformMode was always emitted (fallback move) even for non-transform utilities.

Changes: UtilityTree keeps the ribbon path synced to the pressed leaf and deactivates the utility when its owning collection is collapsed; WorldInstancesLayer requires gumballActive plus an explicit move/rotate/scale transformMode; puzzle 3d/5d only emit transformMode when a transform utility is active. Rebuilt puzzle WASM.

Verified: puzzle gumball_active_only_for_transform test; framework isWorldTransformGumballMode + findPressedUtilityLeafId tests.
